detail.title: Villivakkam Bus Terminus Metro Traffic Diversion
detail.description: To execute the Villivakkam Bus Terminus Metro Station construction work in Reddy Street, a stretch of 200 m length of road from Sivan Kovil South Mada Street to Baliamman Kovil Street been closed. detail.description: To execute the Villivakkam Suburban Metro Station construction work a stretch of 50 m length of road from Kamaraj street towards Villivakkam Market has been closed. So, Commuters are required to use Vegavathy street to reach Market.

Traffic flow towards Pattalam / Otteri Bridge in the Konnur High road, after tank bund road has been blocked and diverted Via Tank Bund Road -> Krishna Dass Street – > Cooks road. Access for pedestrians has been provided along the station to reach Melpatti Ponnapan Street and Madhavaram High Road and crossroads in Jawahar Street (Azad, Thiruvalluvar, Jeevanandham Streets in the east and Kambar, Ashokar Street in the west).

From here, vehicles can take right to reach Kathipara and left to reach Vadapalani towards their destination. No changes for Two Wheelers coming from Porur to Kathipara flyover and they will ply as usual

ADMK Party Office.

detail.description: All the heavy vehicles like Busses coming in Medavakkam main Road towards Kilkattalai will be diverted onto to 100 ft Road at Adambakkam Junction towards the left and progress till Velachery – Tambaram Main Road and then take a Right turn. The L.M.V. coming from Mambalam High Road intending to go to Kodambakkam Bridge side are restricted at the Junction of Thiyagaraya road and they can ply through Thiyagaraya road, North Usman Road to reach their destination. Nagar side are restricted at the Junction of Habibullah Road and they are allowed to ply through Habibullah road and North Usman Road to reach their destination.

detail.description: The vehicles being allowed to ply on Thiyagaraya Road from Panagal Park towards Anna Salai and the same are not allowed from Thanikachalam Road towards Panagal Park. The vehicles including MTC Buses from Thiyagaraya Road intending to go to T. Nagar Bus Stand are allowed to ply on Thanikachalam Road – Burkit Signal – Burkit Road to reach their destination. The vehicles from Nana Street and Sivagnanam Street towards Venkatanarayana road is restricted. Instead, they are allowed to ply on Thanikachalam Road-Venkatanarayana Road to reach their destination.

detail.title: Nandanam Traffic Diversion
detail.description: All the vehicles coming from Anna salai intending to go to Panagal park along VN road is restricted. Instead, those vehicles are allowed to ply on link road to reach VN road via SW Boag Road. 2-way system is implemented along link road.

Moopanar Bridge service road towards Turn Bulls Extension are not allowed.

Raman road and C.P.Ramaswamy road to reach their destination. C.P.Ramasamy Road from C.V. Raman Road junction to R.A.Puram 2nd Main Road Junction is declared as one – way. detail.title: Towards Poonamallee Traffic Diversion
detail.description: The service road towards Poonamalle will be closed at Porur flyover junction. Therefore, Vehicle coming from Kundrathur towards Poonamalle via Porur Flyover service road cannot take a left turn. These vehicles can turn right and take the service road leading towards Guindy and take a U-turn near School Point junction and proceed towards Poonamalle via Porur flyover. Two wheelers coming from Kundrathur towards Poonamalle, take left at the junction of Kundrathur Main Road X Mosque Street before Porur Junction and reach Mount Poonamalle Road towards Poonamalle. All vehicles coming from Vadapalani via Arcot Road take left at Arcot Road X Lakshmi Nagar 40ft road junction and reach Mount Poonamalle Road and proceed towards Poonamalle via Porur flyover. All Vehicles coming from Arcot road towards Porur bridge cannot proceed towards poonamalle. So, these vehicles should take the service road towards Guindy and can take a U turn near School Point junction and proceed towards Poonamalle via Porur flyover. Vehicles coming from Guindy via Mount Poonamalle Road cannot proceed towards Poonamalle via Porur flyover service road. So, these vehicles proceed towards Poonamalle via Porur flyover. Vehicles coming from Poonamalle service road cannot take U turn at Porur flyover junction towards Poonamalle. So, these vehicles can proceed in service road towards Guindy and can take U turn at Mount Poonamalle Road X Ramakrishna Road junction and proceed towards Poonamalle via Porur flyover.

detail.title: Perambur Barracks Traffic Diversion
detail.description: All the Outgoing vehicles coming from Doveton towards Pulianthope Junction are diverted via Vadamalai Street, Arunachalam Street, Venkatesa Bakthan street ( Kosapet). Vehicles coming from Pulianthope junction towards Doveton are diverted through Ashtabujam street –> Rangiah Street –> Avadhanam Papiers road and continuing through Perambur Barracks road, Except MTC Buses. MTC buses towards both directions are now going through Pulianthope High Road or Demellows road – Elephant gate Road – Raja Muthiah Salai and vice versa. 250m length of full Road portion in the Perumbur Barracks road closed for Perumbur Barracks station construction works

detail.title: Pattalam Traffic Diversion
detail.description: Incoming Traffic to Strahans road from Konnur High road, Cooks Road, and Brick Kiln Road are blocked. All the vehicles coming from these Road have been diverted either via Stephenson Road->Dr. Ambedkar College Road –> Pulianthope High Road –> Demellows Road or->Raja Muthaiah Salai to reach Chennai Central or Brick Kiln Road- > Purasaiwakkam High Road to reach Doveton. All Vehicles coming from Perambur Barracks road or De Mellows Road must take Dr.Ambedkar College road-> Stephenson Road to reach Perumbur. Vehicles up to GCC Zonal office -6 is allowed in the Strahans road. 250m length of full Road portion in the Strahans road closed for Pattalam Metro station construction works. LMV can use New Ferrance Road as alternate to Strahans Road.

detail.title: Moolakadai Metro Traffic Diversion
detail.description: Full Closure from Madhavaram High Road to Tondaiyarpet High (T.H.) Road and Sathyavani Muthu Street has been implemented. Dedicated Pedestrian walkway provided from MH road to TH road. Vehicular traffic entry from Moolakadai Junction towards T.H. road is blocked. Only Two wheelers can use Service road of Moolakadai flyover – > Sathyavani Muthu Street to reach Tondaiyarpet High Road. Heavy vehicle access to T.H. Road is currently plying thru Grand Northern Trunk (GNT) Road – One Point – MR Nagar Junction – T.H. Road.

detail.title: Crossover Traffic Diversion
detail.description: Vehicles plying on Madhavaram Red Hills (MRH) Road from Moolakadai detoured near St. Anne’s School and connected back to the existing MRH Road near Reliance Smart Shop. Similarly, the other direction of traffic detoured at Reliance Smart Shop and connected back to the existing road near St. Annes’s School.
